group.name: ModiFace
group.description: ModiFace is a provider of Augmented Reality technology for the beauty industry, ModiFace's patented technology includes 3D makeup simulation, anti-aging/skin-care simulation, hairstyle, and color simulation. Based on more than a decade of advanced facial recognition research at Stanford University and the University of Toronto, ModiFace's technology currently powers augmented reality experiences for brands including Armani, L'Oréal Professionnel, and Samsung.
